nodes.name: Fetch Drive-Time Audience Set
nodes.notes: Loads (account_id, audience_id) tuples classified as drive_time. Fan-out below filters out legacy_geo/unknown audiences so the pusher only updates audiences we manage.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ targeting: { geo_locations: $json.fb_geo_locations.geo_locations, excluded_geo_locations: $json.fb_geo_locations.excluded_geo_locations, targeting_optimization: 'none', targeting_relaxation_types: { lookalike: 0, custom_audience: 0 } } }) }}

nodes.name: Update Saved Audience
nodes.notes: Dual-write: also update the Meta saved audience referenced by this clinic. Forked ad sets won't be backfilled, but new ad sets that reference the saved audience will inherit the update.

nodes.name: If Needs Create
nodes.notes: Route only items needing create AND not in dry-run. Dry-run create requests fall through to If Dry Run (SA) where they're reported as skipped.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $json.sa_audience_name, description: 'Auto-generated by clinic-manager push-targeting', targeting: { geo_locations: $json.fb_geo_locations.geo_locations, excluded_geo_locations: $json.fb_geo_locations.excluded_geo_locations, age_min: 25, age_max: 65, targeting_optimization: 'none', targeting_relaxation_types: { lookalike: 0, custom_audience: 0 } } }) }}

nodes.name: Create Saved Audience
nodes.notes: Auto-creates a saved audience named '{Clinic} ({ST})' when no mapping exists for the (clinic, account).

nodes.notes: Atomic jsonb merge via RPC so concurrent creates for the same clinic don't clobber each other.
